Regarding the Add Person Detail issue, we've confirmed that Jose and Taylor are experiencing two separate issues, not the same one. Taylor's appears to be related to URL routing and is still being investigated. Jose's appears to be a timeout during the save operation and is also still under investigation. We don't have a confirmed fix for either issue yet, but we'll follow up as soon as we have a concrete update.

Regarding the auto-logout and Remember Me behavior, this matches a session timeout change we're already tracking as part of the platform migration. That issue is also still open.

Regarding Dillon, his account is not locked or disabled on our side. Before we proceed, could you please confirm the exact email address he should be using to sign in? I want to make sure it matches what we have on file before resetting his password.

Thank you for your patience.

https://apps.apprissretail.com/bigy/signin

Bringing this to development at Kiran's request. Kiran reproduced it in US DEV as well, so this is not Big Y configuration.

SUMMARY
The Add Suspect post-save redirect targets the legacy path of the case entry page. That path no longer exists after the platform migration. The subject record commits. The redirect is the only failure.

ENVIRONMENTS
Big Y production, apps.apprissretail.com/bigy
US DEV, reproduced by Kiran Vadday on 2026-08-24

REPRODUCTION

  1. Open any incident from Active Incidents.

  2. Incident Workbench > Add.

  3. Select any copy options and click Save.

Expected: land on the entry page of the newly created subject.
Actual: Page Not Found, Error 404.

SCOPE
Two incident types, two different entry pages, identical behaviour.

Shoplifting, MasterCaseID 95063, StoreIdent 380
Redirect goes to /bigy/nettrack/LPMS/CaseEntry.aspx?...&Mode=I and returns 404.
The same page returns 200 at /bigy/nettrack/LPMS/screens/incident/362/lpms/screens/CaseEntry.aspx?...&Mode=I

Credit Card Theft, MasterCaseID 95071, StoreIdent 382
Redirect goes to /bigy/nettrack/LPMS/CaseEntryInternal.aspx?...&Mode=I and returns 404.
The same page returns 200 at /bigy/nettrack/LPMS/screens/incident/362/lpms/screens/CaseEntryInternal.aspx?...&Mode=I

Employee Relations DUI Assessment, MasterCaseID 95070, has no Add button. The flow does not exist for that type.

The redirect fails on every attempt. Three consecutive cycles on 95063 produced ShopliftingID 98912, 98914 and 98916. All three returned 404.

BACKEND ERROR
Requested URL: https://web-prd-wus2-arp-nettrack.azurewebsites.net/nettrack/LPMS/CaseEntryInternal.aspx?MasterCaseID=95071&ShopliftingID=98927&SuspectID=98923&StoreIdent=382&Mode=I
Timestamp: 2026-08-24 22:06:39
Client Slug: /bigy
HTTP Status Code: 404
Type: System.Web.HttpException
Message: The file '/nettrack/LPMS/CaseEntryInternal.aspx' does not exist.
Referrer: /bigy/nettrack/LPMS/lpmseditmenu.aspx?MasterCaseID=95071&ShopliftingID=98922&SuspectID=98918&StoreIdent=382
Stack: System.Web.UI.Util.CheckVirtualFileExists, then BuildManager.GetVPathBuildResultInternal, then PageHandlerFactory.GetHandlerHelper

The same error occurs on Shoplifting at 2026-08-24 18:22:44 with Message: The file '/nettrack/LPMS/CaseEntry.aspx' does not exist.

COMPARISON THAT ISOLATES THE DEFECT
NewIncident.aspx POST returns 302 to /bigy/nettrack/LPMS/screens/incident/362/lpms/screens/CaseEntry.aspx and then 200. The Add Suspect post-save redirect builds /bigy/nettrack/LPMS/CaseEntry.aspx instead.

I rewrote the failing URL by inserting /screens/incident/362/lpms/screens/ and changing nothing else. The page loaded, rendered the new subject, accepted edits and saved. incident.CaseChanges recorded CHANGE.SUSPECT_LASTNAME, CHANGE.SUSPECT_FIRSTNAME and SAVE.CASE at 2026-08-24 18:14:11, and the app reached Incident Confirmation for Case No 26-101-SL-16. The page, the postback and the save all work at the new path.

362 is identical across Shoplifting, Employee Relations DUI and Credit Card Theft. The segment does not derive from the incident type.

RULED OUT
Screen rebuild. I built CaseEntryInternal.aspx from Admin Tools > Screen Designer > Save and Build. Last Build Date moved from 7/29/2026 8:27 AM to 8/24/2026 11:03 PM. I retested three minutes later and got the same 404. CaseEntry.aspx already carried a rebuild dated 8/23/2026 11:31 PM and also still fails.

Workbench links. AdditionalProcessing, LPMSEditMenu, UpdateCaseType, UpdateStatus, ManageAttachments, BlobFileViewer, CaseJournal, ReportNarrative, ConfidentialInvestigativeFile and ConfidentialInvestigativeFileDUI all return 200.

Bookmarks and query strings. The failure reproduces from in-app navigation with a cleared cache. Removing Mode=I, adding viewmode and EditMode, and reordering parameters change nothing.

Data loss. Every failed Add commits its records. incident.MasterCase 95063 stayed present, NumOfSubjects moved 1 to 2, and incident.CaseChanges recorded no delete operation across 22 rows. The Incident Workbench lists the created subjects.

SECONDARY
Static assets return 404 on the error page because the /bigy client slug drops: /nettrack/css/new.css, /nettrack/css/BootStrap-5.3.8.min.css, /nettrack/css/font-awesome.min.css and /nettrack/images/Appriss_Logo.png.

CUSTOMER IMPACT
Big Y reported this on 7/30 and it remains open. Users hit the 404 on every Add. Current workaround: return to the Incident Workbench and use the edit pencil on the new row. Nothing is lost.

NOTE ON THE EARLIER COMMENT
Opening an existing case from the workbench works and always has, including incident type 'Incident'. The failure is Add > Save only. Kiran confirmed that scope in Teams at 4:30 PM.
